listings.name: Little Lucca
listings.label: Little Lucca
listings.address: 724 El Camino Real, South San Francisco, CA 94080
listings.tagline: Hot and cold deli sandwiches on fresh rolls with the shop’s original garlic sauce, made since 1980.
listings.siteNote: Prices are from the shop’s September 2025 printed menu, and the sauces to go from its South San Francisco online ordering page. Salad prices vary by size. Prices are subject to change.

panels.head: Every sandwich
body: Comes with mayo, mustard, pickles, red onion, lettuce, tomato, hot pepper sauce and the original garlic sauce.
Rolls: wheat, sourdough, Dutch crunch, sweet or rustic Italian. Sliced bread: rye or white.
Phone orders 9am–3pm. Phone orders of three or more sandwiches need a credit card.

sections.name: Extra Toppings

listings.name: Minnie Bell’s Soul Movement
listings.label: Minnie Bell’s
listings.cuisine: Soul food and rosemary fried chicken
listings.tagline: Chef Fernay McPherson’s Fillmore soul food spot, built on family recipes and rosemary fried chicken.
listings.siteNote: Prices are from the restaurant’s Toast online ordering menu, read on November 19, 2026.

panels.head: Ordering
body: Pickup and delivery through Toast. Online orders stop 15 minutes before closing.

panels.head: Catering
body: Catering trays for pickup or delivery, scheduled between 10:30am and 3pm.
Fried chicken is $4.50 a piece, or $4.20 each for 35 or more. Pans run $98–$263 and feed up to 25–30 people.

sources.note: Prices from the September 2025 printed menu on littlelucca.com/menu-images; sauces to go from southcity.littlelucca.com. Hours from the printed menu (the South San Francisco page says 8:30am–4pm daily; Apple Maps shows 8:30am–4pm). The phone is on all three menu pages. Turkey, Bacon, Pepper Cheese is printed at $16.26 and kept as printed. Online prices differ in places; the printed menu is used.
gaps: Hours conflict: the printed menu (Sep 2025) says Mon–Fri 8:30am–4pm and Sat–Sun 9am–4pm; the South San Francisco web page’s Store Hours list 8:30am–4pm every day, and its FAQ says online ordering, pickup and delivery start at 9am daily. The listing uses the menu hours.
Phone (650) 589-8916 is confirmed on all three menu pages; the South San Francisco web page shows no number and its Call Us button has an empty phone link.

Salads: the menu says half-pint and pint prices vary per salad but gives one price each without naming the size; the online ordering page shows different half-pint and pint prices (for example potato $5.25 half pint, $10.50 pint).
Turkey, Bacon, Pepper Cheese is printed at $16.26, likely a typo for $16.25; kept as printed. Online ordering lists it at $14.25.

Online ordering prices differ from the printed menu for many items, in both directions (for example Bologna $14.25 online vs $13.95 printed; Tri Tip Special $17.25 online vs $17.95 printed). The menu notes prices are subject to change without notice.

Online ordering also lists items not on the printed menu (Capicola, Turkey BBQ Sauce, Chicken Honey BBQ, hot versions of most sandwiches, $25 and $50 gift cards); these were left out. Hot Sauce 2 oz is listed online at $16.50, the same as a pint, so it was left out as a likely error.
“CAB” after BBQ Beef Brisket is not explained on the menu.
No catering menu or catering prices were found; the South San Francisco page only mentions catering in passing. Delivery is through third-party apps per the site’s FAQ; no delivery details are given.
Parts of the official site carry leftover template content (customer reviews of an unrelated Texas restaurant and a list of Massachusetts zip codes); none of it was used.

sources.note: Address, phone and hours from minniebellssoul.com; menu and prices from its Toast page, read November 19, 2026. Catering from its catering page. No drinks are published.
gaps: Phone conflict: the official site, Toast and the Michelin Guide all give (415) 829-3498; the Instagram contact button’s (510) 879-7199 appears nowhere on the site, so its purpose (old Emeryville or sales line?) is unconfirmed.

Emeryville: the official site lists only the Fillmore location and never mentions Emeryville (apart from an old East Bay Express link on the press page); it gives no closure notice, so the stall’s status is confirmed only by its absence.

Michelin: the Michelin Guide lists it as a recommended restaurant (Southern, $) with no Star or Bib Gourmand; the “award-winning” claim in the Instagram bio isn’t spelled out on the site beyond press links such as the 2017 Chronicle Rising Star Chefs.
No drinks are listed on the Toast menu or the site, so no non-alcoholic drink prices were published.
No descriptions are published for the mac & cheese balls, turkey meatballs, chicken sandwich, sauces, desserts or most sides.
Fried Corn Nibs showed as out of stock on Toast on Nov 19, 2026.
The site FAQ says candied yams are sold only at the counter, but Toast currently lists them ($7 small, $18 large).
Toast shows one menu for lunch and dinner; whether lunch has a different menu could not be confirmed.
